turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and I'd like to know why my son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class. Who decided to enter it, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
I haven't heard an answer yet, Hale. Who entered the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Crazy weather today, eh? Did you see the Flames game?
We're not here about the weather. Who entered the zero, Hale, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
What do you do for fun?
That's not why I'm here, Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, and I'm still waiting for an answer about my son's zero. Withdraw it, or tell me on what basis it was entered.
